title: John Deere is testing JD, an AI assistant for farmers, to help with best practices and find trends based on farmers' "field, machine, and operational data" (Stevie Bonifield/The Verge)
summary: Stevie Bonifield / The Verge: John Deere is testing JD, an AI assistant for farmers, to help with best practices and find trends based on farmers' “field, machine, and operational data” — The new ‘JD’ AI uses farmers' own data to answer questions about their operations and equipment.
contentText:
Stevie Bonifield / The Verge :

John Deere is testing JD, an AI assistant for farmers, to help with best practices and find trends based on farmers' “field, machine, and operational data”   —  ﻿The new ‘JD’ AI uses farmers' own data to answer questions about their operations and equipment.
